commands.name: SET
commands.description: Store a key-value pair with optional expiration time and flags

commands.name: GET
commands.description: Retrieve the value for one or more keys

commands.name: DELETE
commands.description: Remove a key-value pair from the store

commands.name: ADD
commands.description: Store data only if the key does not already exist

commands.name: REPLACE
commands.description: Store data only if the key already exists

commands.name: APPEND
commands.description: Append data to an existing key's value

commands.name: PREPEND
commands.description: Prepend data to an existing key's value

commands.name: GETS
commands.description: Retrieve values with CAS token for check-and-set operations

responseCodes.description: Data not stored (condition not met for add/replace)
CAS check failed, item has been modified
Key not found (for delete, replace, append, prepend)
Response header for GET/GETS containing key data
End of GET/GETS response indicating no more data
